facts.fact: Caspian 被抵在胸口的冰矛惊醒，翻身缩成低伏姿势、喉咙里吼出声音，狼性当即上涌。
facts.quote: An icy spear pressed into my chest. I snapped awake, rolled into a crouch, a growl tearing from my throat before my brain caught up.

facts.fact: Enna 报告说 Marco 和 Major Frost 试着跟进 Max，封死的暗幕把他们挡在外面，谁也没进去。
facts.quote: Marco tried to follow, and Major Frost, and four others. The Veil’s sealed.” Her voice cracked. “None of them got through.

facts.fact: Aelindor 喝令 Spartan 们不要跟进、改为守卫暗幕，随后他与 Drakken、Caspian 三人一起撞进暗幕。
facts.quote:
“Do not follow!” Aelindor barked at our men. “Guard the Veil. That is an order.”



The three of us hit the DarkVeil together.

facts.fact: 穿过暗幕后，Caspian 看见 Max 站在二十英尺外、还活着，头发向上飘仿佛重力倒转。
facts.quote: Max stood twenty feet ahead, back to us, her midnight-blue hair drifting upward as if gravity had reversed. She was alive.

facts.fact: 暗幕里液态金属的银色闪电整体转向三人；暗幕的规则禁死了 Drakken 的变身，Aelindor 的魔法也彻底失效。
facts.quote: Drakken couldn’t shift. Aelindor’s magic was dead.

facts.fact: Max 举起双手、徒手挡下成千上万束液态银火，吼出“THEY. ARE. MINE”，闪电像被头狼压制般退缩并服从。
facts.quote:
“THEY. ARE. MINE,” she roared. “Do not harm what’s mine!”



The lightning recoiled. The entire canopy pulled back

facts.fact: Max 告诉三人自己是目标、催他们先走，Aelindor 却吼出誓言：绝不没有她。
facts.quote:
“I’m not their target. You are,” she snarled.



“Even so, never without you, love.

facts.fact: Max 叫三位 prince 抓住她以免被 Coldiron 击中，又卷起袖子把 Coldiron 灌进 armguard；随后一行四人转身穿过暗幕回到外面。
facts.quote: Together, we turned toward the wall of shadow and pushed through the DarkVeil.

relations: Caspian：狼形 prince，本章叙述者，与 Max 同行同族
Aelindor（Fae heir）与 Drakken（龙 prince）与 Caspian 组成三人组，一同冲入 DarkVeil 救 Max
Aelindor 与 Max：Aelindor 当众立誓“never without you, love”，并说“我们一起走”
Max 与 Coldiron：Max 能徒手压制并吸收 Coldiron；DarkVeil 的规则正是在她体内运作
Enna（Spartan Corporal）：向三位 prince 报告 Max 闯入 DarkVeil
Marco（Commander）与 Frost（Major）加另外四人：试图跟进被暗幕封死，Marco 与 Frost 被灼伤
Max 与三位 prince：Max 宣告“THEY. ARE. MINE”，把三人划为自己人
Nikolai：三人组之一，Caspian 回忆他曾秒杀 warlords
Max 与三人组：他们找了她数十年（“the One”），并曾把她从 Scorched Wastes 拉回来
numbers: less than three seconds from hitting Max
A thousand strands of liquid silver fire froze a dozen feet away
decades of searching for the One
three princes of the Zodiac Covenant
thousands of strands of liquid fire
